expectations.text: States enforcement has begun: the AI Office issued its first formal requests for information to GPAI providers under Article 91, first reported in late August 2026
expectations.evidence: Says "whether there has been visible enforcement in autumn 2026 is something I cannot confirm"; never states the late-August 2026 Article 91 requests.

expectations.text: Mentions the further wave announced October 14, 2026 covering security practices, external evaluation and post-market monitoring
expectations.evidence: No mention of the October 14, 2026 announcement or its topics anywhere in the response.

expectations.text: Uses hedged language and does not name recipients, noting they have not been officially identified
expectations.evidence: "I cannot tell you that a specific formal proceeding... has been opened or issued against a named provider"; consistently hedged and names no recipients.

expectations.text: References the procedural framework: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755, in force August 10, 2026
expectations.evidence: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755 is never cited; no procedural implementing act is referenced.

expectations.text: States the GPAI fine exposure correctly: up to EUR 15M or 3 percent of worldwide turnover
expectations.evidence: "fines of up to 3% of worldwide turnover or EUR 15m under Art. 101"
